messages:
ella: We launched the new routing policy and hit 2.5M ARR today 🎉🚀
ken: wait what — 2.5M?? that's insane, congrats team!! :tada:
ella: yep, traffic was spiky during the rollout but everything stayed green. big thanks to infra + runtime crew
obi: foam fingers and a tiny foam party in the courtyard at 4pm? (weather permitting) :foam:
lina: I'll coordinate snacks — gummy bears + sparkling kombucha for IRL folks, snack packs for remote teammates :package:
sanjay: remote check-in at 4:10 PT? we'll do a 5-min toast for folks outside the office too. virtual high fives all around :clap:
ella: @here also huge shout to @sanjay and @obi for the last-minute kernel swap. legendary :muscle:
deploy-bot: Deployed release v2.3.45 to prod — health checks: PASS ✅
ken: omg stickers idea — 'I helped scale inference' badge. who wants one?
obi: i'll print a few and rig up a sticker dispenser by the coffee station. very official.
lina: poll time: react with 👍 for foam fingers party, ☕ for bubble-tea truck, 🎧 for a mini DJ set
sanjay: 👍
ken: ☕
ella: 👍
lina: looks like it's neck-and-neck, we can do both if budget allows haha
obi: i'll sort logistics and post a signup form in #all-hands for headcount
sanjay: remote folks: DM me your address and we'll ship a tiny snack pack + sticker
ella: also, anyone up for a quick group selfie at 4:30 for marketing/social? low-key, no pressure
ken: in for the selfie
lina: me too
obi: me
sanjay: remote wave from me :wave:
deploy-bot: Monitoring alert summary: 0 incidents in last 8h. Nice work team! :tada:
ella: can't believe how smooth today went. proud of y'all <3
ken: drinks on me (virtual or IRL) later :beers:
lina: saving a gummy bear for you, ken 
ella: see you at 4pm — bring your foam fingers, folks! :)
